text:
anna: quick question — looking at the eu-dedicated pool (pool-eu-g4-1). autoscaler was churning a bit this morning and p95 latency spiked. where do people usually look for per-pool saturation signals? :eyes:

ryan: grafana has a dedicated dashboard for pools: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/pools/dedicated-pools (use the $pool variable). key panels: GPU Util %, GPU mem pressure, inflight_requests, queue_length, avg_batch_size, p50/p95 latency, autoscale_count, scale_decision events.

kevin: traces: jaeger at https://tracing.redwood.com — filter service=runtime-pool and tag pool=pool-eu-g4-1. logs: loki at https://loki.redwood.com with query `{app="runtime", pool="pool-eu-g4-1"}`.

maria: autoscaler decision logs are in ES index `autoscaler.events` (search by pool tag). quick sample query we use in Kibana: `pool:pool-eu-g4-1 AND event.type:scale*`

anna: thanks. the current PagerDuty `PoolSaturated` alert is noisy — fires a lot during short bursts. any recommended tuning?

jess: i'd move to a sustained window + a compound condition. e.g. require: (gpu_util > 0.8 for 3m) AND (queue_length > 100 for 2m) OR (increase(unacked_requests[2m]) > 50). start as severity=warning so SRE can validate.

kevin: can show a PromQL pair we use:
```
avg_over_time(gpu_utilization{pool="pool-eu-g4-1"}[3m]) > 0.8
sum by (pool) (increase(queue_length_total{pool="pool-eu-g4-1"}[2m])) > 100
```

kevin: another useful signal: `batch_fill_rate` — if util high but batch_fill_rate < 0.4 for 5m, it's likely small requests preventing efficient batching (costly & high tail latencies).

maria: also monitor `autoscaler.scale_down_failures` and `autoscaler.scale_up_cooldown_exceeded` metrics — we saw scale_down failures yesterday due to placement constraints.

anna: ok — plan sounds good. can someone create the alert PR and add a short note to the ops runbook with links + rationale? i'll eyeball dashboards after deploy. :thumbsup:

ryan: i'll open a terraform-alerts PR, will set severity=warning and add runbook link. pinging @oncall-sre for post-deploy validation.

infra-bot: deploy triggered for alerts PR #342 (branch: tuning/pool-saturation). CI: passed ✅.

oncall-sre: i'll watch for noise and confirm escalation path. can we also add a grafana panel that overlays `avg_over_time(gpu_util[3m])` + `queue_length` on same time axis? helps correlate.

jess: good idea — add a small annotation for scale events (from autoscaler.events) so you see exactly when a scale decision happened.

anna: sweet. once PR lands i'll run a 30m canary window and report back. thanks all. :rocket:
